stem: A circle in the \(xy\)-plane has its center at \((2, -1)\) and passes through the point \((7, 11)\). An equation of the circle is \((x - 2)^{2} + (y + 1)^{2} = k\), where \(k\) is a constant. What is the value of \(k\)?
solution: \(k\) is the square of the radius, the squared distance from the center to any point on the circle.
verify:
x,y=7,11
k=(x-2)**2+(y+1)**2
assert k==169
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==k
